name: not_or
content:
Notice that `¬(P or Q)`,
$
\begin{array}{|c | c|c|}
\hline
P & Q & \text{¬(P or Q)} \\\\
\hline
T & T & F \\\\
\hline
T & F & F \\\\
\hline
F & T & F \\\\
\hline
F & F & T \\\\
\hline
\end{array}
$

has the same truth table as `¬P and ¬Q`
$
\begin{array}{|c | c|c|}
\hline
P & Q & \text{¬P and ¬Q} \\\\
\hline
T & T & F \\\\
\hline
T & F & F \\\\
\hline
F & T & F \\\\
\hline
F & F & T \\\\
\hline
\end{array}
$

Therefore, they are equivalent and can be interchanged.
